AI.title_translation: 极端事件期间停电的预测建模：整合天气和社会经济因素
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了一个整合天气和社会经济因素的基于学习的框架，用于预测极端事件期间的低概率、高后果停电。通过对比RF、GNN、AdaBoost和LSTM模型，结果显示LSTM在密歇根数据集上取得了最高的准确性。
AI.motivation: 针对极端事件导致的停电进行预测，特别是低概率、高后果的停电情景。通过纳入社会和人口指标，揭示社区脆弱性模式并增进对极端条件下停电风险的理解。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的基于学习的框架。整合了2014年至2024年的EAGLE-I停电记录以及天气、社会经济、基础设施和季节性事件数据。评估了四种机器学习模型：随机森林（RF）、图神经网络（GNN）、自适应增强（AdaBoost）和长短期记忆网络（LSTM）。在密歇根下半岛县的大规模数据集上进行了实验验证。
AI.result: 在所有测试模型中，长短期记忆网络（LSTM）取得了更高的准确性。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种新颖的基于学习的框架，用于预测由极端事件引起的停电。所提出的方法针对低概率、高后果的停电情景，并利用从公开数据源得出的全面特征集。我们将2014年至2024年的EAGLE-I停电记录与天气、社会经济、基础设施和季节性事件数据相结合。纳入社会和人口指标揭示了社区脆弱性的模式，并提高了对极端条件下停电风险的理解。评估了四种机器学习模型，包括随机森林（RF）、图神经网络（GNN）、自适应增强（AdaBoost）和长短期记忆网络（LSTM）。实验验证是在一个涵盖密歇根下半岛县的大规模数据集上进行的。在所有测试模型中，LSTM网络取得了更高的准确性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个新颖的基于学习的框架，用于预测极端事件期间发生的低概率、高后果的停电情景。该方法整合了2014年至2024年的EAGLE-I停电记录以及天气、社会经济、基础设施和季节性事件等综合特征。研究强调，纳入社会和人口指标有助于揭示社区脆弱性并改善对停电风险的理解。通过在密歇根下半岛的大规模数据集上评估RF、GNN、AdaBoost和LSTM四种模型，实验结果显示LSTM网络实现了最高的准确性。
AI.keywords: 停电预测, 极端事件, 社会经济因素, 机器学习, LSTM
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于构建了一个全面的特征集，将传统的环境和基础设施数据与社会经济和人口指标相结合，以更好地捕捉社区在极端事件中的脆弱性。这种多因素集成的方法对于提高低概率、高后果停电情景的预测精度至关重要，为电网弹性规划提供了更细致的工具。该研究通过对比多种先进的机器学习模型（包括GNN和LSTM），明确了在处理此类时间序列和复杂关系数据时，LSTM的优越性。

title: Video-Browser: Towards Agentic Open-web Video Browsing
summary: The evolution of autonomous agents is redefining information seeking, transitioning from passive retrieval to proactive, open-ended web research. However, a significant modality gap remains in processing the web's most dynamic and information-dense modality: video. In this paper, we first formalize the task of Agentic Video Browsing and introduce Video-BrowseComp, a benchmark evaluating open-ended agentic browsing tasks that enforce a mandatory dependency on videos. We observe that current paradigms struggle to reconcile the scale of open-ended video exploration with the need for fine-grained visual verification. Direct visual inference (e.g., RAG) maximizes perception but incurs prohibitive context costs, while text-centric summarization optimizes efficiency but often misses critical visual details required for accurate grounding. To address this, we propose Video-Browser, a novel agent leveraging Pyramidal Perception, filtering with cheap metadata and zooming in with expensive visual perception only when necessary. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves a 37.5% relative improvement while reducing token consumption by 58.3% compared to Direct visual inference, establishing a foundation for verifiable open-web video research. We open-source all codes, benchmark at {https://anonymous.4open.science/r/VideoBrowser} and {https://github.com/chrisx599/Video-Browser}.

AI.title_translation: Video-Browser：迈向智能体开放网络视频浏览
AI.tldr: 本文提出了Video-Browser，这是一个利用“金字塔感知”策略的智能体，旨在解决开放网络视频浏览中的模态鸿沟问题。它通过先使用廉价元数据过滤，再按需使用昂贵视觉感知，实现了37.5%的相对性能提升，同时将代币消耗降低了58.3%。
AI.motivation: 随着自主智能体向主动、开放式网络研究发展，视频作为信息最密集的模态，在处理上存在显著的模态鸿沟。现有范式难以平衡开放式视频探索的规模与细粒度视觉验证的需求，导致直接视觉推理成本过高，而文本中心摘要又丢失关键视觉细节。
AI.method: 1. 形式化了“智能体视频浏览”任务，并引入了基准测试Video-BrowseComp，该基准测试强制依赖于视频。2. 提出了Video-Browser智能体，它采用“金字塔感知”（Pyramidal Perception）策略。该策略首先利用廉价的元数据进行过滤，仅在必要时才“放大”使用昂贵的视觉感知进行细致检查。
AI.result: 相比直接视觉推理方法，Video-Browser实现了37.5%的相对性能提升，同时将代币消耗降低了58.3%。
AI.conclusion: Video-Browser为可验证的开放网络视频研究奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 自主智能体的演进正在重新定义信息搜索，从被动检索转向主动、开放式的网络研究。然而，在处理网络中最具动态性、信息最密集的模态——视频方面，仍然存在显著的模态鸿沟。在本文中，我们首先形式化了“智能体视频浏览”任务，并引入了Video-BrowseComp，这是一个评估开放式智能体浏览任务的基准，这些任务强制依赖于视频。我们观察到，当前的范式难以调和开放式视频探索的规模与细粒度视觉验证的需求。直接视觉推理（例如RAG）最大化了感知能力，但会产生高昂的上下文成本，而以文本为中心的摘要则优化了效率，但经常遗漏准确接地所需的关键视觉细节。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Video-Browser，一个利用“金字塔感知”的新型智能体，它首先使用廉价的元数据进行过滤，仅在必要时才“放大”使用昂贵的视觉感知。实验证明，与直接视觉推理相比，我们的方法实现了37.5%的相对改进，同时减少了58.3%的代币消耗，为可验证的开放网络视频研究奠定了基础。我们开源了所有代码和基准测试。
AI.summary: 本文旨在解决自主智能体在开放式网络研究中处理视频模态的难题。作者首先形式化了“智能体视频浏览”任务，并提出了Video-BrowseComp基准测试。针对现有方法在效率和准确性之间难以平衡的问题，本文提出了Video-Browser智能体，该智能体采用“金字塔感知”策略：先通过廉价元数据进行筛选，再按需进行昂贵的视觉感知。实验结果显示，该方法在性能上相对提升了37.5%，同时将代币消耗降低了58.3%，为可验证的开放网络视频研究建立了基础。
AI.keywords: 智能体视频浏览, 金字塔感知, 开放网络, 模态鸿沟, Video-BrowseComp
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了“金字塔感知”策略来解决开放网络视频浏览中的效率与准确性矛盾。通过分层处理（先廉价过滤，后按需精细感知），该方法有效地降低了自主智能体处理视频时高昂的上下文成本（代币消耗），同时保持了必要的视觉验证能力，这对于推动智能体进行可验证的开放式多模态研究具有重要意义。此外，论文还为这一新兴领域形式化了任务并提供了Video-BrowseComp基准测试。

title: Secure Digital Semantic Communications: Fundamentals, Challenges, and Opportunities
summary: Semantic communication (SemCom) has emerged as a promising paradigm for future wireless networks by prioritizing task-relevant meaning over raw data delivery, thereby reducing communication overhead and improving efficiency. However, shifting from bit-accurate transmission to task-oriented delivery introduces new security and privacy risks. These include semantic leakage, semantic manipulation, knowledge base vulnerabilities, model-related attacks, and threats to authenticity and availability. Most existing secure SemCom studies focus on analog SemCom, where semantic features are mapped to continuous channel inputs. In contrast, digital SemCom transmits semantic information through discrete bits or symbols within practical transceiver pipelines, offering stronger compatibility with realworld systems while exposing a distinct and underexplored attack surface. In particular, digital SemCom typically represents semantic information over a finite alphabet through explicit digital modulation, following two main routes: probabilistic modulation and deterministic modulation. These discrete mechanisms and practical transmission procedures introduce additional vulnerabilities affecting bit- or symbol-level semantic information, the modulation stage, and packet-based delivery and protocol operations. Motivated by these challenges and the lack of a systematic analysis of secure digital SemCom, this paper provides a structured review of the area. Specifically, we review SemCom fundamentals and clarify the architectural differences between analog and digital SemCom. We then summarize threats shared by both paradigms and organize the threat landscape specific to digital SemCom, followed by a discussion of potential defenses. Finally, we outline open research directions toward secure and deployable digital SemCom systems.

AI.title_translation: 安全数字语义通信：基础、挑战与机遇
AI.tldr: 本文对数字语义通信（SemCom）的安全性进行了系统综述，强调了其与模拟SemCom的架构差异，并详细阐述了其离散机制（如调制阶段）带来的独特安全挑战。文章提供了威胁、防御和未来研究方向的结构化分析。
AI.motivation: 语义通信（SemCom）引入了新的安全和隐私风险。现有研究主要集中在模拟SemCom上。数字SemCom因其离散机制和实际传输程序，暴露出独特且未被充分探索的攻击面。本文的动机在于应对这些挑战，并填补安全数字SemCom系统分析的空白。
AI.method: 本文采用结构化综述的方法。具体包括：回顾SemCom基础知识；阐明模拟和数字SemCom的架构差异；总结共享威胁；组织数字SemCom特有的威胁格局；讨论潜在防御措施；并勾勒出开放的研究方向。
AI.result: 结果是提供了一个结构化的分析框架：阐明了模拟和数字SemCom的架构差异，总结了数字SemCom特有的威胁（如调制阶段的漏洞），并提出了未来安全和可部署数字SemCom系统的研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过概述迈向安全和可部署数字SemCom系统的开放研究方向来作结，强调了解决数字SemCom所特有的、由离散机制引入的漏洞的必要性。
AI.translation: 语义通信（SemCom）已成为未来无线网络中一个很有前景的范式，它优先考虑任务相关的含义而非原始数据传输，从而减少了通信开销并提高了效率。然而，从位精确传输转向面向任务的交付引入了新的安全和隐私风险。这些风险包括语义泄漏、语义操纵、知识库漏洞、模型相关攻击以及对真实性和可用性的威胁。大多数现有的安全SemCom研究侧重于模拟SemCom，其中语义特征被映射到连续的信道输入。相比之下，数字SemCom通过实际收发器管道中的离散比特或符号传输语义信息，提供了与现实世界系统更强的兼容性，同时也暴露了一个独特且未被充分探索的攻击面。特别是，数字SemCom通常通过显式的数字调制，以有限字母表的形式表示语义信息，主要遵循两条路径：概率调制和确定性调制。这些离散机制和实际传输过程引入了额外的漏洞，影响了比特或符号级的语义信息、调制阶段以及基于数据包的交付和协议操作。受这些挑战和缺乏对安全数字SemCom系统分析的推动，本文提供了该领域的一个结构化综述。具体来说，我们回顾了SemCom的基础知识，并阐明了模拟和数字SemCom之间的架构差异。然后，我们总结了这两种范式共有的威胁，并组织了数字SemCom特有的威胁格局，随后讨论了潜在的防御措施。最后，我们概述了迈向安全和可部署数字SemCom系统的开放研究方向。
AI.summary: 语义通信（SemCom）提高了效率但引入了新的安全风险。本文关注未被充分探索的数字SemCom，它通过离散比特/符号（如概率或确定性调制）传输，与实际系统兼容性更强，但也带来了独特的攻击面（如调制阶段漏洞）。本文提供了一个结构化综述，阐明了其与模拟SemCom的架构差异，详细组织了数字SemCom特有的威胁格局，并提出了潜在的防御措施和开放的研究方向。
AI.keywords: 安全数字语义通信, 模拟语义通信, 调制, 威胁格局, 无线网络
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于系统地识别和分类了数字语义通信（而非模拟）特有的安全漏洞，例如在调制阶段引入的攻击面。鉴于现实世界的无线系统主要依赖数字传输流程，这项工作至关重要，它为理论上的SemCom安全讨论与实际系统部署之间建立了关键联系，同时解决了兼容性和安全性问题。

title: Many Minds from One Model: Bayesian-Inspired Transformers for Population Diversity
summary: Despite their scale and success, modern transformers are usually trained as single-minded systems: optimization produces a deterministic set of parameters, representing a single functional hypothesis about the data. Motivated by the analogy to human populations, in which population-level intelligence emerges from diverse individual behaviors, we propose Population Bayesian Transformers (B-Trans), which enable sampling diverse yet coherent transformer large language model instances (hereafter referred to as a 'mind') from a single pre-trained LLM. B-Trans introduces a Bayesian-inspired posterior proxy by injecting stochasticity directly into normalization layers, avoiding the prohibitive cost of training full Bayesian neural networks. Sampling from this proxy yields a population of minds with diverse behaviors while maintaining general competence. During the generation of each response, we sample a single realization from the random distribution and hold it fixed, ensuring temporal consistency and reasoning coherence. Experiments on zero-shot generation and Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) demonstrate that B-Trans effectively leverages the stochastic model diversity, yielding superior response diversity while achieving better task performance compared to deterministic baselines.

AI.title_translation: 一模多心：贝叶斯启发式Transformer实现群体多样性
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Population Bayesian Transformers (B-Trans) 的方法，通过在预训练LLM中注入随机性来采样出多样化但连贯的Transformer实例（“心智”），从而在保持通用能力的同时提高响应多样性和任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现代Transformer模型通常是单一系统，优化产生一组确定性参数，代表对数据的单一功能假设。受人类社会中群体智能源于多样化个体行为的启发，研究旨在从单一模型中生成多样化的Transformer实例。
AI.method: B-Trans通过在归一化层中直接注入随机性来引入一个贝叶斯启发式的后验代理，从而避免了训练完整贝叶斯神经网络的高昂成本。从该代理中采样可以得到一个具有多样化行为但保持通用能力的“心智”群体。在每次响应生成过程中，从随机分布中采样一个单一实现并保持固定，以确保时间一致性和推理连贯性。
AI.result: 在零样本生成和带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）实验中，B-Trans有效利用了随机模型的多样性，与确定性基线相比，产生了卓越的响应多样性，同时实现了更好的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: B-Trans通过贝叶斯启发式的方法，在Transformer模型中引入了有效的随机性，成功地从单一预训练LLM中生成了多样化且高性能的“心智”群体，显著提升了响应多样性和任务表现。
AI.translation: 尽管规模庞大且取得了成功，但现代Transformer模型通常被训练为单一系统：优化会产生一组确定性参数，代表对数据的单一功能假设。受人类群体智能源于多样化个体行为的启发，我们提出了群体贝叶斯Transformer（B-Trans），它能够从单一预训练大型语言模型中采样出多样化但连贯的Transformer实例（此后称为“心智”）。B-Trans通过直接在归一化层中注入随机性，引入了一个贝叶斯启发式的后验代理，从而避免了训练完整贝叶斯神经网络的高昂成本。从该代理中采样可以得到一个具有多样化行为但保持通用能力的“心智”群体。在每次响应生成过程中，我们从随机分布中采样一个单一实现并保持固定，以确保时间一致性和推理连贯性。在零样本生成和带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）实验中，B-Trans证明了其有效利用随机模型多样性的能力，与确定性基线相比，产生了卓越的响应多样性，同时实现了更好的任务性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Population Bayesian Transformers (B-Trans)，旨在解决传统Transformer模型缺乏多样性的问题。B-Trans通过在归一化层中注入贝叶斯启发式的随机性，从单一预训练LLM中采样出多样化且连贯的Transformer实例（“心智”），从而避免了完整的贝叶斯神经网络训练成本。实验证明，B-Trans在零样本生成和RLVR任务中，在保持通用能力的同时，显著提高了响应多样性并取得了更好的任务性能。
AI.keywords: 贝叶斯Transformer, 模型多样性, 大型语言模型, 随机性, 群体智能
AI.comments: 这项工作具有创新性，它通过在Transformer的标准化层中引入随机性，有效地解决了传统LLM单一性问题，实现了从一个模型中生成多样化但连贯的“心智”。这种贝叶斯启发式的方法成本效益高，为探索模型多样性提供了一个实用的途径，对于提高LLM在复杂任务中的鲁棒性和创造性具有重要意义。

title: Quantifier Elimination Meets Treewidth
summary: In this paper, we address the complexity barrier inherent in Fourier-Motzkin elimination (FME) and cylindrical algebraic decomposition (CAD) when eliminating a block of (existential) quantifiers. To mitigate this, we propose exploiting structural sparsity in the variable dependency graph of quantified formulas. Utilizing tools from parameterized algorithms, we investigate the role of treewidth, a parameter that measures the graph's tree-likeness, in the process of quantifier elimination. A novel dynamic programming framework, structured over a tree decomposition of the dependency graph, is developed for applying FME and CAD, and is also extensible to general quantifier elimination procedures. Crucially, we prove that when the treewidth is a constant, the framework achieves a significant exponential complexity improvement for both FME and CAD, reducing the worst-case complexity bound from doubly exponential to single exponential. Preliminary experiments on sparse linear real arithmetic (LRA) and nonlinear real arithmetic (NRA) benchmarks confirm that our algorithm outperforms the existing popular heuristic-based approaches on instances exhibiting low treewidth.

AI.tldr: 通过将树宽概念应用于量词消除（FME/CAD），我们设计了一种新的基于树分解的动态规划方法，证明了在低树宽下，可以将量词消除的复杂度从双指数级显著降低到单指数级。
AI.motivation: 旨在克服傅里叶-莫茨金消元（FME）和柱状代数分解（CAD）在消除一组（存在性）量词时固有的复杂度瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的、基于依赖图的树分解上的动态规划框架，用于应用傅里叶-莫茨金消元（FME）和柱状代数分解（CAD），该框架可扩展到一般量词消除过程。
AI.result: 当树宽为常数时，该框架为FME和CAD实现了显著的指数级复杂度改进，将最坏情况复杂度界限从双指数级降低到单指数级。初步实验证实，该算法在具有低树宽的稀疏线性实数算术（LRA）和非线性实数算术（NRA）基准测试中优于现有的基于启发式的流行方法。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们解决了在消除一组（存在性）量词时，傅里叶-莫茨金消元（FME）和柱状代数分解（CAD）固有的复杂度障碍。为减轻此问题，我们建议利用量化公式的变量依赖图中的结构稀疏性。利用参数化算法中的工具，我们研究了树宽——一个衡量图的类树特性的参数——在量词消除过程中的作用。我们为应用FME和CAD开发了一种新颖的、基于依赖图的树分解上的动态规划框架，该框架也可扩展到一般的量词消除过程。至关重要的是，我们证明了当树宽为常数时，该框架为FME和CAD实现了显著的指数级复杂度改进，将最坏情况复杂度界限从双指数级降低到单指数级。在稀疏线性实数算术（LRA）和非线性实数算术（NRA）基准测试上的初步实验证实，我们的算法在表现出低树宽的实例上优于现有的基于启发式的流行方法。
AI.summary: 本文针对量词消除中固有的复杂度问题，提出了一种利用变量依赖图中的结构稀疏性的方法。通过引入参数化算法中的树宽概念，开发了一个基于依赖图树分解的动态规划框架来执行FME和CAD。当树宽为常数时，该方法能将复杂度从双指数级降至单指数级，并在低树宽的实际算术问题实例上表现出优越性。
AI.keywords: 量词消除, 树宽, 傅里叶-莫茨金消元, 柱状代数分解, 参数化算法
AI.comments: 这项工作的主要创新在于将参数化复杂性理论中的树宽概念引入到量词消除算法（如FME和CAD）中，从而在特定结构（低树宽）下实现了复杂度上的显著突破，从双指数级降低到单指数级。其重要性在于为解决高维量词消除的“复杂度爆炸”问题提供了一种理论上和实践上都更优的解决方案。局限性在于其主要优势仅在树宽为常数时才能体现。

title: Entropy Production in Machine Learning Under Fokker-Planck Probability Flow
summary: Machine learning models deployed in nonstationary environments inevitably experience performance degradation due to data drift. While numerous drift detection heuristics exist, most lack a dynamical interpretation and provide limited guidance on how retraining decisions should be balanced against operational cost. In this work, we propose an entropy-based retraining framework grounded in nonequilibrium statistical physics. Interpreting drift as probability flow governed by a Fokker-Planck equation, we quantify model-data mismatch using relative entropy and show that its time derivative admits an entropy-balance decomposition featuring a nonnegative entropy production term driven by probability currents. Guided by this theory, we implement an entropy-triggered retraining policy using an exponentially weighted moving-average (EWMA) control statistic applied to a streaming kernel density estimator of the Kullback-Leibler divergence. We evaluate this approach across multiple nonstationary data streams. In synthetic, financial, and web-traffic domains, entropy-based retraining achieves predictive performance comparable to frequent retraining while reducing retraining frequency by one to two orders of magnitude. However, in a challenging biomedical ECG setting, the entropy-based trigger underperforms the maximum-frequency baseline, highlighting limitations of feature-space entropy monitoring under complex label-conditional drift.

AI.title_translation: Fokker-Planck概率流下机器学习中的熵产生
AI.tldr: 研究人员提出了一种基于物理学（Fokker-Planck方程和熵产生）的新方法来检测数据漂移并决定何时重新训练ML模型，成功地大幅减少了再训练次数，但在某些复杂情况下效果不佳。
AI.motivation: 部署在非平稳环境中的机器学习模型会因数据漂移而性能下降，现有的漂移检测方法缺乏动力学解释，且难以指导再训练决策与操作成本之间的权衡。
AI.method: 将数据漂移解释为由Fokker-Planck方程控制的概率流，使用相对熵量化模型-数据失配，并利用熵平衡分解来识别非负的熵产生项。实际实施中，使用指数加权移动平均（EWMA）控制统计量应用于Kullback-Leibler散度的流式核密度估计器来触发再训练。
AI.result: 在合成、金融和网络流量域中，基于熵的再训练在保持性能的同时，将再训练频率降低了1到2个数量级。但在生物医学ECG场景中，其性能逊于最大频率基线。
AI.conclusion: 基于熵的再训练策略在多个非平稳数据流中实现了与频繁再训练相当的性能，同时将再训练频率降低了一到两个数量级。然而，在具有复杂标签条件漂移的生物医学ECG场景中，该方法表现不佳。
AI.translation: 部署在非平稳环境中的机器学习模型不可避免地会因数据漂移而导致性能下降。尽管存在许多漂移检测的启发式方法，但大多数缺乏动力学解释，并且对再训练决策应与操作成本如何权衡提供的指导有限。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于非平衡统计物理学的基于熵的再训练框架。我们将漂移解释为由Fokker-Planck方程控制的概率流，使用相对熵量化模型-数据失配，并证明其时间导数可以分解为熵平衡，其中包含一个由概率流驱动的非负熵产生项。受该理论指导，我们使用应用于Kullback-Leibler散度流式核密度估计器的指数加权移动平均（EWMA）控制统计量，实现了一种熵触发的再训练策略。我们在多个非平稳数据流上评估了这种方法。在合成、金融和网络流量域中，基于熵的再训练实现了与频繁再训练相当的预测性能，同时将再训练频率降低了一到两个数量级。然而，在具有挑战性的生物医学ECG设置中，基于熵的触发器表现不如最大频率基线，突显了特征空间熵监测在复杂标签条件漂移下的局限性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于非平衡统计物理的熵驱动再训练框架，用于解决机器学习模型在数据漂移下的性能下降问题。该框架将漂移视为Fokker-Planck方程控制的概率流，利用相对熵及其时间导数的熵产生项来量化模型-数据失配。通过EWMA控制的KL散度估计来触发再训练，实验证明该方法在多个领域显著降低了再训练频率，但对复杂的标签条件漂移敏感。
AI.keywords: 数据漂移, 熵产生, Fokker-Planck方程, 再训练策略, 相对熵
AI.comments: 这项工作创新性地将非平衡统计物理（特别是Fokker-Planck方程和熵产生原理）引入机器学习中的数据漂移检测和再训练决策。其重要性在于提供了一种基于物理学的、可解释的漂移量化方法，并显著降低了再训练频率。局限性在于在复杂的标签条件漂移场景（如生物医学ECG数据）中表现不如最大频率基线。

title: Robust and Efficient Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-Tuning via Adaptive Bayesian Subspace Optimizer
summary: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) with zeroth-order (ZO) optimization reduces memory by approximating gradients through function evaluations. However, existing methods essentially perform updates in a one-dimensional space, and suffer from collapse or substantial performance degradation under low-precision training. We introduce BSZO, an adaptive \textbf{B}ayesian \textbf{S}ubspace \textbf{Z}eroth-Order \textbf{O}ptimizer, which applies Kalman filtering to combine finite-difference information across multiple perturbation directions within a subspace. By treating each finite-difference measurement as a noisy observation, BSZO builds a posterior distribution over the subspace-projected gradient and updates it through Bayesian inference, with a residual-based adaptive mechanism to adapt to noise variations. Theoretical analysis shows that BSZO improves the convergence rate by a factor of $k/γ$ compared to standard ZO methods. Experiments on RoBERTa, Mistral, and OPT models show that BSZO outperforms the baselines across various tasks, achieving up to 6.67\% absolute average improvement on OPT-13B while remaining robust under fp16/bf16 precision and keeping memory usage close to inference-only baselines (1.00$\times$--1.08$\times$ of MeZO).

AI.title_translation: 通过自适应贝叶斯子空间优化器实现的鲁棒高效的零阶LLM微调
AI.tldr: BSZO是一种新的零阶LLM微调方法，它使用卡尔曼滤波和贝叶斯推断来在子空间内优化梯度，解决了现有方法的低精度性能下降问题，理论上提高了收敛速度，并在实际模型上取得了更好的性能和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的零阶（ZO）优化方法在通过函数评估近似梯度进行LLM微调时，存在仅在一维空间中进行更新的问题，这导致在低精度训练下容易出现崩溃或显著的性能下降。
AI.method: 引入了自适应贝叶斯子空间零阶优化器（BSZO），该方法利用卡尔曼滤波将多个扰动方向上的有限差分信息结合到子空间内。它将每次有限差分测量视为噪声观测，通过贝叶斯推断构建子空间投影梯度的后验分布，并采用基于残差的自适应机制来适应噪声变化。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，BSZO与标准ZO方法相比，收敛速度提高了$k/γ$的因子。实验结果显示，BSZO在RoBERTa、Mistral和OPT模型上优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: BSZO在多个任务上超越了基线方法，在OPT-13B上实现了高达6.67%的绝对平均提升，同时在fp16/bf16精度下保持鲁棒性，并将内存使用保持在接近仅推理的基线水平（MeZO的1.00$\times$--1.08$\times$）。
AI.translation: 使用零阶（ZO）优化进行大型语言模型（LLM）的微调通过函数评估来近似梯度，从而减少内存占用。然而，现有方法本质上是在一维空间中进行更新，并且在低精度训练下容易出现崩溃或显著的性能下降。我们引入了BSZO，一种自适应的**贝叶斯子空间零阶优化器**，它利用卡尔曼滤波将来自多个扰动方向的有限差分信息在子空间内进行整合。通过将每次有限差分测量视为噪声观测，BSZO构建了子空间投影梯度的后验分布，并通过贝叶斯推断进行更新，同时采用基于残差的自适应机制来适应噪声变化。理论分析表明，与标准ZO方法相比，BSZO的收敛速度提高了$k/γ$的因子。在RoBERTa、Mistral和OPT模型上的实验表明，BSZO在各种任务上都优于基线方法，在OPT-13B上实现了高达6.67%的绝对平均提升，同时在fp16/bf16精度下保持鲁棒性，并将内存使用量保持在接近仅推理的基线水平（MeZO的1.00$\times$--1.08$\times$）。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为BSZO的自适应贝叶斯子空间零阶优化器，用于解决现有零阶LLM微调方法在低精度训练下性能差的问题。BSZO利用卡尔曼滤波和贝叶斯推断在子空间内整合多方向的有限差分信息，并通过残差机制自适应噪声。理论上和实验上均证明了BSZO具有更快的收敛速度和更强的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 零阶优化, LLM微调, 贝叶斯优化, 子空间, 卡尔曼滤波
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于引入了基于卡尔曼滤波的自适应贝叶斯子空间优化器（BSZO），解决了现有零阶优化方法在低精度训练下性能下降的问题，并通过理论分析证明了其收敛速度的提升。其实验结果有力地验证了其在多个LLM上的有效性和鲁棒性。

title: FFP-300K: Scaling First-Frame Propagation for Generalizable Video Editing
summary: First-Frame Propagation (FFP) offers a promising paradigm for controllable video editing, but existing methods are hampered by a reliance on cumbersome run-time guidance. We identify the root cause of this limitation as the inadequacy of current training datasets, which are often too short, low-resolution, and lack the task diversity required to teach robust temporal priors. To address this foundational data gap, we first introduce FFP-300K, a new large-scale dataset comprising 300K high-fidelity video pairs at 720p resolution and 81 frames in length, constructed via a principled two-track pipeline for diverse local and global edits. Building on this dataset, we propose a novel framework designed for true guidance-free FFP that resolves the critical tension between maintaining first-frame appearance and preserving source video motion. Architecturally, we introduce Adaptive Spatio-Temporal RoPE (AST-RoPE), which dynamically remaps positional encodings to disentangle appearance and motion references. At the objective level, we employ a self-distillation strategy where an identity propagation task acts as a powerful regularizer, ensuring long-term temporal stability and preventing semantic drift. Comprehensive experiments on the EditVerseBench benchmark demonstrate that our method significantly outperforming existing academic and commercial models by receiving about 0.2 PickScore and 0.3 VLM score improvement against these competitors.

AI.title_translation: FFP-300K：扩展首帧传播以实现可泛化的视频编辑
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了FFP-300K数据集和一种新的无引导视频编辑框架，通过AST-RoPE和自蒸馏策略解决了现有方法的局限性，并在EditVerseBench基准测试中取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有视频编辑方法依赖于繁琐的运行时引导，其根本原因是当前训练数据集过短、分辨率低且缺乏任务多样性，无法学习鲁棒的时序先验。为解决这一数据鸿沟，研究提出了FFP-300K数据集和一个新的无引导FFP框架。
AI.method: 研究提出了FFP-300K数据集，包含300K个高保真视频对，分辨率为720p，长度为81帧。还提出了一个无引导FFP框架，引入了自适应时空RoPE（AST-RoPE）来解耦外观和运动参考，并采用自蒸馏策略，以身份传播任务作为正则化器，确保长期时序稳定性和防止语义漂移。
AI.result: 在EditVerseBench基准测试上的实验表明，该方法显著优于现有的学术和商业模型，在PickScore和VLM分数上分别提高了约0.2和0.3。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过引入大规模FFP-300K数据集和创新的无引导FFP框架，有效解决了现有视频编辑方法的局限性，并在性能上取得了显著提升。
AI.translation: 首帧传播（FFP）为可控视频编辑提供了一个有前景的范例，但现有方法受限于对繁琐运行时引导的依赖。我们认为这一局限性的根本原因是当前训练数据集的不足，它们通常过短、分辨率低，并且缺乏教授鲁棒时序先验所需的任务多样性。为解决这一基础数据差距，我们首先引入了FFP-300K，这是一个新的大规模数据集，包含300K个720p分辨率、81帧长的、经过原则性双轨道流水线构建的高保真视频对，以实现多样化的局部和全局编辑。在此数据集的基础上，我们提出了一个专为真正无引导FFP设计的新颖框架，它解决了保持首帧外观和保留源视频运动之间的关键矛盾。在架构上，我们引入了自适应时空RoPE（AST-RoPE），它动态地重新映射位置编码，以解耦外观和运动参考。在目标层面，我们采用了一种自蒸馏策略，其中身份传播任务充当强大的正则化器，确保长期时序稳定性和防止语义漂移。在EditVerseBench基准测试上的全面实验表明，我们的方法通过比竞争对手提高约0.2的PickScore和0.3的VLM分数，显著优于现有的学术和商业模型。
AI.summary: 该研究通过构建大规模FFP-300K数据集和提出一种新的无引导视频编辑框架，解决了现有方法对运行时引导的依赖问题。新框架利用AST-RoPE解耦外观和运动，并通过自蒸馏保持时序稳定性，实验证明其性能优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 首帧传播, 视频编辑, 数据集, AST-RoPE, 自蒸馏
AI.comments: 该研究在视频编辑领域取得了重要进展，通过构建大规模数据集和提出创新的无引导框架，有效解决了现有方法的局限性。AST-RoPE和自蒸馏策略的设计具有新颖性，并在实验中得到了验证。然而，未来可以进一步探索该方法在更广泛的视频编辑任务和不同数据集上的泛化能力。

title: Meta-Learning Guided Pruning for Few-Shot Plant Pathology on Edge Devices
summary: A key challenge in agricultural AI is deploying disease detection systems in remote fields with limited access to laboratories or high-performance computing (HPC) resources. While deep learning (DL) models, specifically deep convolutional networks, achieve high accuracy in identifying plant pathologies from leaf imagery, their memory footprints and computational demands limit edge deployment on devices constrained by battery life, processing power, and connectivity, such as Raspberry Pi. Few-shot learning (FSL) paradigms offer a compelling solution to the data scarcity problem inherent in agricultural applications, where obtaining labeled samples for novel disease variants proves both costly and time-sensitive. This work introduces a framework combining pruning with meta-learning for agricultural disease classification, addressing the tension between generalization capability and deployment feasibility. The proposed approach combines a novel Disease-Aware Channel Importance Scoring (DACIS) mechanism with a three-stage Prune-then-Meta-Learn-then-Prune (PMP) pipeline. Experiments on PlantVillage and PlantDoc datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach reduces model size by 78\% while maintaining 92.3\% of the original accuracy. The compressed model achieves 7 frames per second (FPS) on a Raspberry Pi 4, enabling practical real-time field diagnosis for smallholder farmers.

AI.title_translation: 面向边缘设备的少样本植物病理元学习引导剪枝
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种结合剪枝和元学习的框架，用于农业病害分类，以解决泛化能力和部署可行性之间的矛盾。实验表明，该方法在减小模型尺寸的同时，能保持高精度，并能在树莓派等边缘设备上实现实时诊断。
AI.motivation: 在农业人工智能领域，将疾病检测系统部署到远程且计算资源有限的野外环境中是一个关键挑战。深度学习模型虽然准确，但其内存和计算需求限制了在电池寿命、处理能力和连接性受限的边缘设备上的部署。少样本学习（FSL）为农业应用中固有的数据稀缺性问题提供了一种解决方案。
AI.method: 提出了一种结合剪枝和元学习的框架，该框架包含新颖的疾病感知通道重要性评分（DACIS）机制，以及一个三阶段的“先剪枝-元学习-再剪枝”（PMP）流程。
AI.result: 该方法将模型尺寸减小了78%，同时保持了原始准确度的92.3%。压缩后的模型在树莓派4上实现了每秒7帧（FPS）的处理速度。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的结合剪枝和元学习的框架能够显著减小模型尺寸，同时保持高精度，并能在树莓派等边缘设备上实现高效的植物病理实时诊断，为小农户提供了实际应用价值。
AI.translation: 在农业人工智能领域，一个关键的挑战是将疾病检测系统部署到远程、缺乏实验室或高性能计算（HPC）资源的地区。虽然深度学习（DL）模型，特别是深度卷积网络，在从叶片图像识别植物病理方面取得了高准确率，但它们的内存占用和计算需求限制了它们在电池寿命、处理能力和连接性受限的设备（如树莓派）上的边缘部署。少样本学习（FSL）范式为农业应用中固有的数据稀缺性问题提供了一个引人注目的解决方案，因为获取新疾病变种的标记样本既昂贵又耗时。本研究引入了一个结合剪枝和元学习的框架，用于农业疾病分类，解决了泛化能力和部署可行性之间的矛盾。所提出的方法结合了一种新颖的疾病感知通道重要性评分（DACIS）机制和三阶段的“先剪枝-元学习-再剪枝”（PMP）流程。在PlantVillage和PlantDoc数据集上的实验表明，所提出的方法将模型尺寸减小了78%，同时保持了原始准确度的92.3%。压缩后的模型在树莓派4上实现了每秒7帧（FPS）的处理速度，为小农户提供了实际的实时现场诊断能力。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种创新的框架，通过结合元学习和剪枝技术来解决在边缘设备上部署植物病理检测模型的挑战。该框架利用疾病感知通道重要性评分（DACIS）和三阶段的“先剪枝-元学习-再剪枝”（PMP）流程，旨在提高模型的效率和可部署性。实验结果表明，该方法能够显著减小模型尺寸（减少78%），同时几乎不损失准确度（保留92.3%），并且在树莓派4等资源受限的设备上实现了可观的处理速度（7 FPS），为在资源匮乏的农业环境中进行实时病害诊断提供了可行方案。
AI.keywords: 元学习, 模型剪枝, 边缘设备, 植物病理, 少样本学习
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地结合了元学习和模型剪枝技术，以解决在资源受限的边缘设备上部署高效植物病理检测模型的实际问题。DACIS机制和PMP流程的设计具有创新性，能够有效平衡模型的准确性和计算效率。实验结果令人印象深刻，证明了该方法在减小模型尺寸和提高推理速度方面的有效性，并能在实际的边缘设备上实现实时性能，这对于农业领域的应用具有重要意义。未来的工作可以进一步探索该方法在更多样化的植物病理数据集和更广泛的边缘计算平台上的适应性。

title: VINO: A Unified Visual Generator with Interleaved OmniModal Context
summary: We present VINO, a unified visual generator that performs image and video generation and editing within a single framework. Instead of relying on task-specific models or independent modules for each modality, VINO uses a shared diffusion backbone that conditions on text, images and videos, enabling a broad range of visual creation and editing tasks under one model. Specifically, VINO couples a vision-language model (VLM) with a Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MMDiT), where multimodal inputs are encoded as interleaved conditioning tokens, and then used to guide the diffusion process. This design supports multi-reference grounding, long-form instruction following, and coherent identity preservation across static and dynamic content, while avoiding modality-specific architectural components. To train such a unified system, we introduce a multi-stage training pipeline that progressively expands a video generation base model into a unified, multi-task generator capable of both image and video input and output. Across diverse generation and editing benchmarks, VINO demonstrates strong visual quality, faithful instruction following, improved reference and attribute preservation, and more controllable multi-identity edits. Our results highlight a practical path toward scalable unified visual generation, and the promise of interleaved, in-context computation as a foundation for general-purpose visual creation.

AI.title_translation: VINO：一个统一的、具有交错全模态上下文的视觉生成器
AI.tldr: VINO是一个统一的视觉生成框架，通过共享的扩散骨干和交错的多模态上下文，实现了图像和视频的生成与编辑，无需特定任务的模型，并展示了在生成质量、指令遵循和属性保留方面的优势。
AI.motivation: 开发一个能够处理图像和视频生成与编辑的统一框架，克服现有方法依赖特定任务模型或独立模块的局限性。
AI.method: VINO结合了视觉-语言模型（VLM）和多模态扩散Transformer（MMDiT），将文本、图像和视频作为交错的条件令牌进行编码，以指导扩散过程。采用多阶段训练流程，从视频生成模型逐步扩展为多任务生成器。
AI.result: VINO在生成质量、指令遵循、参考和属性保留方面表现出色，并能进行可控的多身份编辑，证明了其作为通用视觉创作基础的潜力。
AI.conclusion: VINO展示了一条通往可扩展的统一视觉生成的实用路径，并强调了交错的、上下文内的计算作为通用视觉创作基础的潜力。
AI.translation: 我们提出了VINO，一个统一的视觉生成器，在一个框架内执行图像和视频的生成与编辑。VINO不依赖于特定任务的模型或每个模态的独立模块，而是使用一个共享的扩散骨干，它以文本、图像和视频为条件，在一个模型下实现了广泛的视觉创作和编辑任务。具体来说，VINO将视觉-语言模型（VLM）与多模态扩散Transformer（MMDiT）相结合，其中多模态输入被编码为交错的条件令牌，然后用于指导扩散过程。这种设计支持多参考基础、长指令遵循以及在静态和动态内容之间保持一致的身份，同时避免了特定模态的架构组件。为了训练这样一个统一的系统，我们引入了一个多阶段训练流程，该流程逐步将一个视频生成基础模型扩展为一个统一的、能够处理图像和视频输入和输出的多任务生成器。在各种生成和编辑基准测试中，VINO展示了强大的视觉质量、忠实的指令遵循、改进的参考和属性保留，以及更可控的多身份编辑。我们的结果突显了一条通往可扩展的统一视觉生成的实用路径，以及交错的、上下文内的计算作为通用视觉创作基础的潜力。
AI.summary: VINO是一个新颖的统一视觉生成框架，它利用共享的扩散骨干和交错的全模态上下文，在一个模型中实现了图像和视频的生成与编辑。该方法通过结合VLM和MMDiT，将多模态输入编码为条件令牌，实现了多参考基础、长指令遵循和身份保持等高级功能，同时避免了特定模态的架构。其多阶段训练流程和在各项基准测试中的优异表现，证明了其在可扩展性和通用视觉创作方面的潜力。
AI.keywords: 统一视觉生成, 全模态上下文, 扩散模型, VLM, MMDiT
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为VINO的创新统一视觉生成框架，通过集成多模态输入和共享扩散骨干，显著简化了图像和视频的生成与编辑流程。其核心贡献在于利用交错的全模态上下文，实现了超越传统特定任务模型的灵活性和性能。研究中提出的多阶段训练策略和对多参考、长指令遵循及身份保持的关注，为未来通用视觉创作模型的发展奠定了坚实基础。然而，对于大规模部署的计算成本和在更复杂、多样化场景下的鲁棒性仍需进一步探索。

title: LLM-as-evaluator in Strategy Research: A Normative, Variance-Aware Protocol
comments: 41 pages for the main paper 53 pages for appendix
summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer strategy researchers powerful tools for annotating text at scale, but treating LLM-generated labels as deterministic overlooks substantial instability. Grounded in content analysis and generalizability theory, we diagnose five variance sources: construct specification, interface effects, model preferences, output extraction, and system-level aggregation. Empirical demonstrations show that minor design choices-prompt phrasing, model selection-can shift outcomes by 12-85 percentage points. Such variance threatens not only reproducibility but econometric identification: annotation errors correlated with covariates bias parameter estimates regardless of average accuracy. We develop a variance-aware protocol specifying sampling budgets, aggregation rules, and reporting standards, and delineate scope conditions where LLM annotation should not be used. These contributions transform LLM-based annotation from ad hoc practice into auditable measurement infrastructure.
comment: 41 pages for the main paper 53 pages for appendix

AI.title_translation: LLM作为评估者在战略研究中的应用：一个规范的、方差感知的协议
AI.tldr: LLM在战略研究中用于文本标注时存在不稳定性，应采用方差感知协议以确保可复现性和计量经济学识别。
AI.motivation: 将LLM生成的标签视为确定性的做法忽略了其固有的不稳定性，这可能影响研究的可复现性和计量经济学识别。
AI.method: 通过内容分析和可推广性理论诊断了五种方差来源（构造规范、接口效应、模型偏好、输出提取和系统级聚合），并开发了一个包含采样预算、聚合规则和报告标准的方差感知协议。
AI.result: 研究表明，微小的设计选择（如提示措辞、模型选择）会导致结果变化12-85个百分点，并且注释误差与协变量相关会偏估计参数。
AI.conclusion: LLM作为评估者的应用应从临时的实践转变为可审计的测量基础设施，并明确了不应使用LLM注释的范围条件。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）为战略研究人员提供了大规模注释文本的强大工具，但将LLM生成的标签视为确定性的做法忽略了其显著的不稳定性。基于内容分析和可推广性理论，我们诊断了五种方差来源：构造规范、接口效应、模型偏好、输出提取和系统级聚合。实证演示表明，微小的设计选择——提示措辞、模型选择——可能导致结果变化12-85个百分点。这种方差不仅威胁到可复现性，还威胁到计量经济学识别：注释误差与协变量相关会偏估计参数，无论平均准确性如何。我们开发了一个方差感知的协议，规定了采样预算、聚合规则和报告标准，并界定了不应使用LLM注释的范围条件。这些贡献将基于LLM的注释从临时的实践转变为可审计的测量基础设施。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了在战略研究中使用大型语言模型（LLMs）进行文本标注时存在的不稳定性问题。研究人员发现，将LLM的标注视为确定性的会忽略其固有的方差，这些方差来源于五个方面：构造规范、接口效应、模型偏好、输出提取和系统级聚合。实证结果表明，即使是微小的设计选择（如提示措辞和模型选择）也会导致结果发生显著变化（12-85个百分点）。这种不稳定性不仅影响研究的可复现性，还会因注释误差与协变量相关而偏估计计量经济学模型的参数。为解决这些问题，研究提出并开发了一种方差感知的协议，该协议规定了采样预算、聚合规则和报告标准，并明确了不应使用LLM标注的范围条件。最终目标是将LLM标注从一种临时的实践转变为一种可审计的测量基础设施。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 战略研究, 文本标注, 方差感知协议, 可复现性
AI.comments: 该研究强调了在战略研究中使用LLM进行文本标注时的潜在陷阱，并提出了一个重要的解决方案——方差感知协议。这对于提高研究的严谨性和可信度至关重要。然而，协议的具体实施细节和在不同研究场景下的适用性仍需进一步探索。

title: A Fourth-Order Cut-cell Multigrid Method for Solving Elliptic Equations on Arbitrary Domains
summary: To numerically solve a generic elliptic equation on two-dimensional domains with rectangular Cartesian grids, we propose a cut-cell geometric multigrid method that features (1) general algorithmic steps that apply to two-dimensional constant-coefficient elliptic equations with both divergence and non-divergence forms and all types of boundary conditions, (2) the versatility of handling both regular and irregular domains with arbitrarily complex topology and geometry, (3) the fourth-order accuracy even at the presence of ${\cal C}^1$ discontinuities on the domain boundary, and (4) the optimal complexity of $O(h^{-2})$.Test results demonstrate the generality, accuracy, efficiency, robustness, and excellent conditioning of the proposed method.

AI.title_translation: 任意域上的四阶切割单元多重网格法求解椭圆方程
AI.tldr: 一种新的四阶精度切割单元几何多重网格方法，用于在二维任意复杂几何区域上高效、鲁棒地求解椭圆方程。
AI.motivation: 需要一种能够处理任意二维几何区域、具有高精度和最优复杂度的数值方法来求解椭圆方程。
AI.method: 提出了一种切割单元几何多重网格方法，该方法具有通用的算法步骤，适用于二维常系数椭圆方程（包括散度和非散度形式）和所有类型的边界条件，能够处理具有任意拓扑和几何形状的规则和不规则域，即使在域边界存在C1不连续性时也能达到四阶精度，并具有O(h^-2)的最优复杂度。
AI.result: 测试结果证明了该方法的通用性、准确性、效率、鲁棒性和优良的条件数。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的切割单元几何多重网格方法能够通用、准确、高效、鲁棒且条件良好地求解任意二维域上的椭圆方程。
AI.translation: 为了在二维区域上数值求解一个通用的椭圆方程，我们提出了一个在矩形笛卡尔网格上的切割单元几何多重网格方法，该方法具有以下特点：(1) 通用的算法步骤，适用于二维常系数椭圆方程的散度和非散度形式以及所有类型的边界条件；(2) 处理具有任意复杂拓扑和几何形状的规则和不规则域的多功能性；(3) 即使在域边界存在 ${\cal C}^1$ 不连续性时也能达到四阶精度；(4) 具有 $O(h^{-2})$ 的最优复杂度。测试结果证明了该方法的通用性、准确性、效率、鲁棒性和优良的条件数。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于求解二维任意域上椭圆方程的四阶精度切割单元几何多重网格方法。该方法通用性强，适用于各种形式的椭圆方程和边界条件，能够处理复杂几何形状，并具有最优复杂度。测试结果验证了该方法的准确性、效率和鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 切割单元, 多重网格法, 椭圆方程, 四阶精度, 任意域
AI.comments: 该方法在处理复杂几何形状和提高求解精度方面取得了显著进展，特别是在边界存在不连续性时仍能保持四阶精度，这对于实际工程应用具有重要意义。其最优复杂度也保证了方法的计算效率。

title: LLMs, You Can Evaluate It! Design of Multi-perspective Report Evaluation for Security Operation Centers
summary: Security operation centers (SOCs) often produce analysis reports on security incidents, and large language models (LLMs) will likely be used for this task in the near future. We postulate that a better understanding of how veteran analysts evaluate reports, including their feedback, can help produce analysis reports in SOCs. In this paper, we aim to leverage LLMs for analysis reports. To this end, we first construct a Analyst-wise checklist to reflect SOC practitioners' opinions for analysis report evaluation through literature review and user study with SOC practitioners. Next, we design a novel LLM-based conceptual framework, named MESSALA, by further introducing two new techniques, granularization guideline and multi-perspective evaluation. MESSALA can maximize report evaluation and provide feedback on veteran SOC practitioners' perceptions. When we conduct extensive experiments with MESSALA, the evaluation results by MESSALA are the closest to those of veteran SOC practitioners compared with the existing LLM-based methods. We then show two key insights. We also conduct qualitative analysis with MESSALA, and then identify that MESSALA can provide actionable items that are necessary for improving analysis reports.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型，你可以评估它！安全运营中心的多视角报告评估设计
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为MESSALA的新型基于大型语言模型的框架，用于安全运营中心（SOC）的分析报告评估。通过结合分析师清单、细粒度化指南和多视角评估，MESSALA在评估结果上最接近资深分析师的看法，并能提供改进报告的可操作建议。
AI.motivation: 安全运营中心（SOC）在安全事件分析报告的生成中，未来可能会广泛使用大型语言模型（LLM）。为了提高报告质量，需要更好地理解资深分析师如何评估报告及其反馈意见。
AI.method: 首先，通过文献综述和与SOC从业者的用户研究构建了一个“分析师清单”，以反映SOC从业者对分析报告评估的意见。然后，设计了一个名为MESSALA的新型基于LLM的概念框架，引入了“细粒度化指南”和“多视角评估”技术。
AI.result: 通过广泛的实验，MESSALA在评估结果上最接近资深SOC从业者的看法，优于现有的基于LLM的方法。此外，定性分析表明MESSALA能够提供改进分析报告所必需的可操作项目。
AI.conclusion: MESSALA框架通过结合分析师清单、细粒度化指南和多视角评估，能够有效地对SOC分析报告进行评估，并且其评估结果与资深分析师的看法高度一致，同时能提供有价值的改进建议。
AI.translation: 安全运营中心（SOC）经常会生成安全事件的分析报告，并且大型语言模型（LLM）很可能在不久的将来被用于此任务。我们假设，更深入地了解资深分析师如何评估报告，包括他们的反馈意见，有助于在SOC中生成分析报告。在本研究中，我们的目标是利用LLM来处理分析报告。为此，我们首先通过文献综述和与SOC从业者的用户研究，构建了一个“分析师清单”，以反映SOC从业者对分析报告评估的意见。接下来，我们设计了一个名为MESSALA的新型基于LLM的概念框架，通过进一步引入“细粒度化指南”和“多视角评估”两项新技术。MESSALA能够最大化报告评估效果，并根据资深SOC从业者的看法提供反馈。当我们使用MESSALA进行广泛的实验时，与其他现有的基于LLM的方法相比，MESSALA的评估结果最接近资深SOC从业者的看法。然后，我们展示了两个关键见解。我们还使用MESSALA进行了定性分析，并确定MESSALA能够提供改进分析报告所必需的可操作项目。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为MESSALA的新型LLM驱动的框架，用于评估安全运营中心（SOC）的分析报告。该框架结合了分析师清单、细粒度化指南和多视角评估，旨在模拟资深分析师的评估过程。实验证明，MESSALA的评估结果比现有LLM方法更接近资深分析师的判断，并能提供可操作的改进建议。
AI.keywords: 安全运营中心, 分析报告, 大型语言模型, 报告评估, MESSALA
AI.comments: 该研究在LLM应用于安全领域方面具有重要意义，特别是在报告评估这一关键环节。MESSALA框架的设计融合了领域专家知识和先进的LLM技术，解决了自动化报告评估的挑战。然而，其在真实SOC环境中的部署和长期效果仍需进一步验证。

title: Local Intrinsic Dimensionality of Ground Motion Data for Early Detection of Complex Catastrophic Slope Failure
summary: Local Intrinsic Dimensionality (LID) has shown strong potential for identifying anomalies and outliers in high-dimensional data across a wide range of real-world applications, including landslide failure detection in granular media. Early and accurate identification of failure zones in landslide-prone areas is crucial for effective geohazard mitigation. While existing approaches typically rely on surface displacement data analyzed through statistical or machine learning techniques, they often fall short in capturing both the spatial correlations and temporal dynamics that are inherent in such data. To address this gap, we focus on ground-monitored landslides and introduce a novel approach that jointly incorporates spatial and temporal information, enabling the detection of complex landslides and including multiple successive failures occurring in distinct areas of the same slope. To be specific, our method builds upon an existing LID-based technique, known as sLID. We extend its capabilities in three key ways. (1) Kinematic enhancement: we incorporate velocity into the sLID computation to better capture short-term temporal dependencies and deformation rate relationships. (2) Spatial fusion: we apply Bayesian estimation to aggregate sLID values across spatial neighborhoods, effectively embedding spatial correlations into the LID scores. (3) Temporal modeling: we introduce a temporal variant, tLID, that learns long-term dynamics from time series data, providing a robust temporal representation of displacement behavior. Finally, we integrate both components into a unified framework, referred to as spatiotemporal LID (stLID), to identify samples that are anomalous in either or both dimensions. Extensive experiments show that stLID consistently outperforms existing methods in failure detection precision and lead-time.

title: Identification of a Kalman filter: consistency of local solutions
comments: Submitted for review to the proceedings of the IFAC World Congress 2026
summary: Prediction error and maximum likelihood methods are powerful tools for identifying linear dynamical systems and, in particular, enable the joint estimation of model parameters and the Kalman filter used for state estimation. A key limitation, however, is that these methods require solving a generally non-convex optimization problem to global optimality. This paper analyzes the statistical behavior of local minimizers in the special case where only the Kalman gain is estimated. We prove that these local solutions are statistically consistent estimates of the true Kalman gain. This follows from asymptotic unimodality: as the dataset grows, the objective function converges to a limit with a unique local (and therefore global) minimizer. We further provide guidelines for designing the optimization problem for Kalman filter tuning and discuss extensions to the joint estimation of additional linear parameters and noise covariances. Finally, the theoretical results are illustrated using three examples of increasing complexity. The main practical takeaway of this paper is that difficulties caused by local minimizers in system identification are, at least, not attributable to the tuning of the Kalman gain.
comment: Submitted for review to the proceedings of the IFAC World Congress 2026

title: TSSR: Two-Stage Swap-Reward-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Character-Level SMILES Generation
summary: The design of reliable, valid, and diverse molecules is fundamental to modern drug discovery, as improved molecular generation supports efficient exploration of the chemical space for potential drug candidates and reduces the cost of early design efforts. Despite these needs, current chemical language models that generate molecules as SMILES strings are vulnerable to compounding token errors: many samples are unparseable or chemically implausible, and hard constraints meant to prevent failure can restrict exploration. To address this gap, we introduce TSSR, a Two-Stage, Swap-Reward-driven reinforcement learning (RL) framework for character-level SMILES generation. Stage one rewards local token swaps that repair syntax, promoting transitions from invalid to parseable strings. Stage two provides chemistry-aware feedback from RDKit diagnostics, rewarding reductions in valence, aromaticity, and connectivity issues. The reward decomposes into interpretable terms (swap efficiency, error reduction, distance to validity), is model agnostic, and requires no task-specific labels or hand-crafted grammars. We evaluated TSSR on the MOSES benchmark using a GRU policy trained with PPO in both pure RL (P-RL) from random initialization and fine-tuning RL (F-RL) starting from a pretrained chemical language model, assessing 10,000 generated SMILES per run. In P-RL, TSSR significantly improves syntactic validity, chemical validity, and novelty. In F-RL, TSSR preserves drug-likeness and synthesizability while increasing validity and novelty. Token-level analysis shows that syntax edits and chemistry fixes act jointly to reduce RDKit detected errors. TSSR converts a sparse terminal objective into a denser and more interpretable reward, improving both syntactic and chemical quality without reducing diversity. TSSR is dataset-agnostic and can be adapted to various reinforcement learning approaches.

title: Responsibility Measures for Conjunctive Queries with Negation
summary: We contribute to the recent line of work on responsibility measures that quantify the contributions of database facts to obtaining a query result. In contrast to existing work which has almost exclusively focused on monotone queries, here we explore how to define responsibility measures for unions of conjunctive queries with negated atoms (UCQ${}^\lnot$). Starting from the question of what constitutes a reasonable notion of explanation or relevance for queries with negated atoms, we propose two approaches, one assigning scores to (positive) database facts and the other also considering negated facts. Our approaches, which are orthogonal to the previously studied score of Reshef et al., can be used to lift previously studied scores for monotone queries, known as drastic Shapley and weighted sums of minimal supports (WSMS), to UCQ$^\lnot$. We investigate the data and combined complexity of the resulting measures, notably showing that the WSMS measures are tractable in data complexity for all UCQ${}^\lnot$ queries and further establishing tractability in combined complexity for suitable classes of conjunctive queries with negation.

title: 5G NR Non-Terrestrial Networks: From Early Results to the Road Ahead
comments: 8 pages, 2 figures. This paper has been accepted to npj Wireless Technology for publication
summary: This paper overviews the 3GPP 5G NR-NTN standard, detailing the evolution from Rel. 18 to 19 and innovations for Rel. 20. Using realistic ns-3 simulations validated against 3GPP calibration data, we evaluate various satellite network configurations. The results highlight the potential of NTNs to extend wireless connectivity to remote areas, serve requests during emergency, and alleviate terrestrial network congestion.

title: Multivector Reranking in the Era of Strong First-Stage Retrievers
summary: Learned multivector representations power modern search systems with strong retrieval effectiveness, but their real-world use is limited by the high cost of exhaustive token-level retrieval. Therefore, most systems adopt a \emph{gather-and-refine} strategy, where a lightweight gather phase selects candidates for full scoring. However, this approach requires expensive searches over large token-level indexes and often misses the documents that would rank highest under full similarity. In this paper, we reproduce several state-of-the-art multivector retrieval methods on two publicly available datasets, providing a clear picture of the current multivector retrieval field and observing the inefficiency of token-level gathering. Building on top of that, we show that replacing the token-level gather phase with a single-vector document retriever -- specifically, a learned sparse retriever (LSR) -- produces a smaller and more semantically coherent candidate set. This recasts the gather-and-refine pipeline into the well-established two-stage retrieval architecture. As retrieval latency decreases, query encoding with two neural encoders becomes the dominant computational bottleneck. To mitigate this, we integrate recent inference-free LSR methods, demonstrating that they preserve the retrieval effectiveness of the dual-encoder pipeline while substantially reducing query encoding time. Finally, we investigate multiple reranking configurations that balance efficiency, memory, and effectiveness, and we introduce two optimization techniques that prune low-quality candidates early. Empirical results show that these techniques improve retrieval efficiency by up to 1.8$\times$ with no loss in quality. Overall, our two-stage approach achieves over $24\times$ speedup over the state-of-the-art multivector retrieval systems, while maintaining comparable or superior retrieval quality.

title: Stock Market Price Prediction using Neural Prophet with Deep Neural Network
comments: Accepted at 2nd International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON) 2025
summary: Stock market price prediction is a significant interdisciplinary research domain that depends at the intersection of finance, statistics, and economics. Forecasting Accurately predicting stock prices has always been a focal point for various researchers. However, existing statistical approaches for time-series prediction often fail to effectively forecast the probability range of future stock prices. Hence, to solve this problem, the Neural Prophet with a Deep Neural Network (NP-DNN) is proposed to predict stock market prices. The preprocessing technique used in this research is Z-score normalization, which normalizes stock price data by removing scale differences, making patterns easier to detect. Missing value imputation fills gaps in historical data, enhancing the models use of complete information for more accurate predictions. The Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) learns complex nonlinear relationships among stock market prices and extracts hidden patterns from the input data, thereby creating meaningful feature representations for better prediction accuracy. The proposed NP-DNN model achieved an accuracy of 99.21% compared with other approaches using the Fused Large Language Model. Keywords: deep neural network, forecasting stock prices, multi-layer perceptron, neural prophet, stock market price prediction.
comment: Accepted at 2nd International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON) 2025

title: Do Sparse Autoencoders Identify Reasoning Features in Language Models?
summary: We investigate whether sparse autoencoders (SAEs) identify genuine reasoning features in large language models (LLMs). We first show through a simple theoretical analysis that $\ell_1$-regularized SAEs are intrinsically biased toward low-dimensional patterns, providing a mechanistic explanation for why shallow linguistic cues may be preferentially captured over distributed reasoning behaviors. Motivated by this bias, we introduce a falsification-oriented evaluation framework that combines causal token injection and LLM-guided falsification to test whether feature activation reflects reasoning processes or superficial linguistic correlates. Across 20 configurations spanning multiple model families, layers, and reasoning datasets, we find that features identified by contrastive methods are highly sensitive to token-level interventions, with 45% to 90% activating when a small number of associated tokens are injected into non-reasoning text. For the remaining features, LLM-guided falsification consistently produces non-reasoning inputs that activate the feature and reasoning inputs that do not, with no analyzed feature satisfying our criteria for genuine reasoning behavior. Steering these features yields no improvements in benchmark performance. Overall, our results suggest that SAE features identified by current contrastive approaches primarily capture linguistic correlates of reasoning rather than the underlying reasoning computations themselves. Code is available at https://github.com/GeorgeMLP/reasoning-probing.

title: SceneFoundry: Generating Interactive Infinite 3D Worlds
summary: The ability to automatically generate large-scale, interactive, and physically realistic 3D environments is crucial for advancing robotic learning and embodied intelligence. However, existing generative approaches often fail to capture the functional complexity of real-world interiors, particularly those containing articulated objects with movable parts essential for manipulation and navigation. This paper presents SceneFoundry, a language-guided diffusion framework that generates apartment-scale 3D worlds with functionally articulated furniture and semantically diverse layouts for robotic training. From natural language prompts, an LLM module controls floor layout generation, while diffusion-based posterior sampling efficiently populates the scene with articulated assets from large-scale 3D repositories. To ensure physical usability, SceneFoundry employs differentiable guidance functions to regulate object quantity, prevent articulation collisions, and maintain sufficient walkable space for robotic navigation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework generates structurally valid, semantically coherent, and functionally interactive environments across diverse scene types and conditions, enabling scalable embodied AI research. project page: https://anc891203.github.io/SceneFoundry-Demo/

title: FACTUM: Mechanistic Detection of Citation Hallucination in Long-Form RAG
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models are critically undermined by citation hallucinations, a deceptive failure where a model cites a source that fails to support its claim. While existing work attributes hallucination to a simple over-reliance on parametric knowledge, we reframe this failure as an evolving, scale-dependent coordination failure between the Attention (reading) and Feed-Forward Network (recalling) pathways. We introduce FACTUM (Framework for Attesting Citation Trustworthiness via Underlying Mechanisms), a framework of four mechanistic scores: Contextual Alignment (CAS), Attention Sink Usage (BAS), Parametric Force (PFS), and Pathway Alignment (PAS). Our analysis reveals that correct citations are consistently marked by higher parametric force (PFS) and greater use of the attention sink (BAS) for information synthesis. Crucially, we find that "one-size-fits-all" theories are insufficient as the signature of correctness evolves with scale: while the 3B model relies on high pathway alignment (PAS), our best-performing 8B detector identifies a shift toward a specialized strategy where pathways provide distinct, orthogonal information. By capturing this complex interplay, FACTUM outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by up to 37.5% in AUC. Our results demonstrate that high parametric force is constructive when successfully coordinated with the Attention pathway, paving the way for more nuanced and reliable RAG systems.

title: iReasoner: Trajectory-Aware Intrinsic Reasoning Supervision for Self-Evolving Large Multimodal Models
summary: Recent work shows that large multimodal models (LMMs) can self-improve from unlabeled data via self-play and intrinsic feedback. Yet existing self-evolving frameworks mainly reward final outcomes, leaving intermediate reasoning weakly constrained despite its importance for visually grounded decision making. We propose iReasoner, a self-evolving framework that improves an LMM's implicit reasoning by explicitly eliciting chain-of-thought (CoT) and rewarding its internal agreement. In a Proposer--Solver loop over unlabeled images, iReasoner augments outcome-level intrinsic rewards with a trajectory-aware signal defined over intermediate reasoning steps, providing learning signals that distinguish reasoning paths leading to the same answer without ground-truth labels or external judges. Starting from Qwen2.5-VL-7B, iReasoner yields up to $+2.1$ points across diverse multimodal reasoning benchmarks under fully unsupervised post-training. We hope this work serves as a starting point for reasoning-aware self-improvement in LMMs in purely unsupervised settings.

title: Cascading multi-agent anomaly detection in surveillance systems via vision-language models and embedding-based classification
summary: Intelligent anomaly detection in dynamic visual environments requires reconciling real-time performance with semantic interpretability. Conventional approaches address only fragments of this challenge. Reconstruction-based models capture low-level deviations without contextual reasoning, object detectors provide speed but limited semantics, and large vision-language systems deliver interpretability at prohibitive computational cost. This work introduces a cascading multi-agent framework that unifies these complementary paradigms into a coherent and interpretable architecture. Early modules perform reconstruction-gated filtering and object-level assessment, while higher-level reasoning agents are selectively invoked to interpret semantically ambiguous events. The system employs adaptive escalation thresholds and a publish-subscribe communication backbone, enabling asynchronous coordination and scalable deployment across heterogeneous hardware. Extensive evaluation on large-scale monitoring data demonstrates that the proposed cascade achieves a threefold reduction in latency compared to direct vision-language inference, while maintaining high perceptual fidelity (PSNR = 38.3 dB, SSIM = 0.965) and consistent semantic labeling. The framework advances beyond conventional detection pipelines by combining early-exit efficiency, adaptive multi-agent reasoning, and explainable anomaly attribution, establishing a reproducible and energy-efficient foundation for scalable intelligent visual monitoring.

title: Incentive Mechanism Design for Privacy-Preserving Decentralized Blockchain Relayers
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Public blockchains, though renowned for their transparency and immutability, suffer from significant privacy concerns. Network-level analysis and long-term observation of publicly available transactions can often be used to infer user identities. To mitigate this, several blockchain applications rely on relayers, which serve as intermediary nodes between users and smart contracts deployed on the blockchain. However, dependence on a single relayer not only creates a single point of failure but also introduces exploitable vulnerabilities that weaken the system's privacy guarantees. This paper proposes a decentralized relayer architecture that enhances privacy and reliability through game-theoretic incentive design. We model the interaction among relayers as a non-cooperative game and design an incentive mechanism in which probabilistic uploading emerges as a unique mixed Nash equilibrium. Using evolutionary game analysis, we demonstrate the equilibrium's stability against perturbations and coordinated deviations. Through numerical evaluations, we analyze how equilibrium strategies and system behavior evolve with key parameters such as the number of relayers, upload costs, rewards, and penalties. In particular, we show that even with high transaction costs, the system maintains reliability with an outage probability below 0.05 . Furthermore, our results highlight a fundamental trade-off between privacy, reliability, robustness, and cost in decentralized relayer systems.
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication

title: V2P: Visual Attention Calibration for GUI Grounding via Background Suppression and Center Peaking
comments: This work was intended as a replacement of arXiv:2508.13634 and any subsequent updates will appear there
summary: Precise localization of GUI elements is crucial for the development of GUI agents. Traditional methods rely on bounding box or center-point regression, neglecting spatial interaction uncertainty and visual-semantic hierarchies. Recent methods incorporate attention mechanisms but still face two key issues: (1) ignoring processing background regions causes attention drift from the desired area, and (2) uniform modeling the target UI element fails to distinguish between its center and edges, leading to click imprecision. Inspired by how humans visually process and interact with GUI elements, we propose the Valley-to-Peak (V2P) method to address these issues. To mitigate background distractions, V2P introduces a suppression attention mechanism that minimizes the model's focus on irrelevant regions to highlight the intended region. For the issue of center-edge distinction, V2P applies a Fitts' Law-inspired approach by modeling GUI interactions as 2D Gaussian heatmaps where the weight gradually decreases from the center towards the edges. The weight distribution follows a Gaussian function, with the variance determined by the target's size. Consequently, V2P effectively isolates the target area and teaches the model to concentrate on the most essential point of the UI element. The model trained by V2P achieves the performance with 92.4\% and 52.5\% on two benchmarks ScreenSpot-v2 and ScreenSpot-Pro (see Fig.~\ref{fig:main_results_charts}). Ablations further confirm each component's contribution, underscoring V2P's generalizability in precise GUI grounding tasks and its potential for real-world deployment in future GUI agents.

title: Beyond Hard Masks: Progressive Token Evolution for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer a promising alternative for language modeling by enabling parallel decoding through iterative refinement. However, most DLMs rely on hard binary masking and discrete token assignments, which hinder the revision of early decisions and underutilize intermediate probabilistic representations. In this paper, we propose EvoToken-DLM, a novel diffusion-based language modeling approach that replaces hard binary masks with evolving soft token distributions. EvoToken-DLM enables a progressive transition from masked states to discrete outputs, supporting revisable decoding. To effectively support this evolution, we introduce continuous trajectory supervision, which aligns training objectives with iterative probabilistic updates. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks show that EvoToken-DLM consistently achieves superior performance, outperforming strong diffusion-based and masked DLM baselines. Project webpage: https://aim-uofa.github.io/EvoTokenDLM.

AI.title_translation: 超越硬掩码：面向扩散语言模型的渐进式Token演化
AI.tldr: 提出EvoToken-DLM，用渐进式软Token分布取代DLM中的硬掩码，通过连续轨迹监督实现可修改的并行解码，并在多个基准测试中取得了优越的性能。

title: UIKA: Fast Universal Head Avatar from Pose-Free Images
summary: We present UIKA, a feed-forward animatable Gaussian head model from an arbitrary number of unposed inputs, including a single image, multi-view captures, and smartphone-captured videos. Unlike the traditional avatar method, which requires a studio-level multi-view capture system and reconstructs a human-specific model through a long-time optimization process, we rethink the task through the lenses of model representation, network design, and data preparation. First, we introduce a UV-guided avatar modeling strategy, in which each input image is associated with a pixel-wise facial correspondence estimation. Such correspondence estimation allows us to reproject each valid pixel color from screen space to UV space, which is independent of camera pose and character expression. Furthermore, we design learnable UV tokens on which the attention mechanism can be applied at both the screen and UV levels. The learned UV tokens can be decoded into canonical Gaussian attributes using aggregated UV information from all input views. To train our large avatar model, we additionally prepare a large-scale, identity-rich synthetic training dataset. Our method significantly outperforms existing approaches in both monocular and multi-view settings. See more details in our project page: https://zijian-wu.github.io/uika-page/

AI.title_translation: UIKA：基于无姿态图像的快速通用头部替身模型
AI.tldr: 介绍UIKA，一个快速、前馈、通用的高斯头部替身模型，可从任意数量的无姿态输入（单图、多视角或视频）中生成，通过UV引导建模和新的大规模合成数据集，性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统替身模型需要工作室级多视角捕获系统和长时间优化来重建特定于人类的模型；本文旨在通过模型表示、网络设计和数据准备的重新思考，实现从任意数量的无姿态输入快速生成通用头部替身。
AI.method: 提出了UIKA，一个前馈的可动画高斯头部模型。核心方法包括：引入UV引导的替身建模策略，通过像素级面部对应估计将有效像素颜色从屏幕空间重投影到UV空间；设计可学习的UV tokens，并在屏幕和UV级别应用注意力机制；利用聚合的UV信息将UV tokens解码为规范高斯属性。此外，还准备了一个大规模、身份丰富的合成训练数据集。
AI.result: 在单目和多视角设置中，该方法显著优于现有方法。
AI.translation: 我们提出了UIKA，一个可从任意数量的无姿态输入（包括单张图像、多视角捕获和智能手机拍摄的视频）中生成的前馈可动画高斯头部模型。与需要工作室级多视角捕获系统并通过长时间优化过程重建特定于人类模型的传统替身方法不同，我们从模型表示、网络设计和数据准备的角度重新思考了这项任务。首先，我们引入了UV引导的替身建模策略，其中每张输入图像都与像素级面部对应估计相关联。这种对应估计使我们能够将每个有效的像素颜色从屏幕空间重投影到UV空间，而这与相机姿态和角色表情无关。此外，我们设计了可学习的UV tokens，可以在屏幕和UV级别上应用注意力机制。学习到的UV tokens可以使用来自所有输入视角的聚合UV信息解码为规范的高斯属性。为了训练我们的大型替身模型，我们额外准备了一个大规模、身份丰富的合成训练数据集。我们的方法在单目和多视角设置中均显著优于现有方法。

title: Discovery and Reinforcement of Tool-Integrated Reasoning Chains via Rollout Trees
summary: Tool-Integrated Reasoning has emerged as a key paradigm to augment Large Language Models (LLMs) with computational capabilities, yet integrating tool-use into long Chain-of-Thought (long CoT) remains underexplored, largely due to the scarcity of training data and the challenge of integrating tool-use without compromising the model's intrinsic long-chain reasoning. In this paper, we introduce DART (Discovery And Reinforcement of Tool-Integrated Reasoning Chains via Rollout Trees), a reinforcement learning framework that enables spontaneous tool-use during long CoT reasoning without human annotation. DART operates by constructing dynamic rollout trees during training to discover valid tool-use opportunities, branching out at promising positions to explore diverse tool-integrated trajectories. Subsequently, a tree-based process advantage estimation identifies and credits specific sub-trajectories where tool invocation positively contributes to the solution, effectively reinforcing these beneficial behaviors. Extensive experiments on challenging benchmarks like AIME and GPQA-Diamond demonstrate that DART significantly outperforms existing methods, successfully harmonizing tool execution with long CoT reasoning.

AI.title_translation: 通过滚出树发现和强化工具集成推理链
AI.tldr: DART是一个新的RL框架，它使用“滚出树”在训练中自动发现和强化LLM进行复杂推理时使用工具的最佳时机和方式，解决了数据稀疏问题，并在推理基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 工具集成推理（Tool-Integrated Reasoning）是增强LLM计算能力的关键范式，但将工具使用集成到长思维链（long CoT）中研究不足，主要原因是缺乏训练数据以及担心工具使用会损害模型固有的长链推理能力。
AI.method: DART（Discovery And Reinforcement of Tool-Integrated Reasoning Chains via Rollout Trees）框架，它通过在训练期间构建动态滚出树来发现有效的工具使用机会，并探索多样化的工具集成轨迹。然后，使用基于树的过程优势估计来识别和奖励工具调用带来积极贡献的特定子轨迹，从而强化这些有益的行为。
AI.result: DART在AIME和GPQA-Diamond等具有挑战性的基准测试中，显著优于现有方法，成功地将工具执行与长CoT推理协调起来。
AI.conclusion: DART作为一个强化学习框架，成功地在没有人工标注的情况下，通过滚出树机制发现了并强化了工具集成的推理链，实现了工具执行与长CoT推理的和谐统一。

title: Distribution Estimation with Side Information
summary: We consider the classical problem of discrete distribution estimation using i.i.d. samples in a novel scenario where additional side information is available on the distribution. In large alphabet datasets such as text corpora, such side information arises naturally through word semantics/similarities that can be inferred by closeness of vector word embeddings, for instance. We consider two specific models for side information--a local model where the unknown distribution is in the neighborhood of a known distribution, and a partial ordering model where the alphabet is partitioned into known higher and lower probability sets. In both models, we theoretically characterize the improvement in a suitable squared-error risk because of the available side information. Simulations over natural language and synthetic data illustrate these gains.

AI.title_translation: 带有辅助信息的分布估计
AI.tldr: 在具有辅助信息的场景下，通过局部模型或偏序模型，理论上改进了离散分布估计的均方误差风险，并通过仿真验证了收益。
AI.motivation: 在i.i.d.样本的离散分布估计经典问题中引入了辅助信息的场景。
AI.method: 提出局部模型和偏序模型，理论上分析了辅助信息对均方误差风险的改进，并通过仿真进行验证。
AI.result: 理论上表征了辅助信息带来的均方误差风险的改进，并通过自然语言和合成数据上的模拟进行了说明。
AI.conclusion: 辅助信息能够理论上改进离散分布估计的均方误差风险，并通过仿真得到验证。
AI.translation: 我们考虑使用i.i.d.样本在一种新颖的场景下进行离散分布估计的经典问题，在这种场景下可以获得关于该分布的附加辅助信息。在像文本语料库这样的大字母数据集（large alphabet datasets）中，通过词语语义/相似性可以自然地获得这种辅助信息，例如，可以通过向量词嵌入的接近度来推断。我们考虑了两种特定的辅助信息模型——一种局部模型，其中未知分布是已知分布的邻域；另一种偏序模型，其中字母表被划分为已知的更高和更低概率集合。在这两种模型中，我们都从理论上表征了由于可用辅助信息而带来的合适均方误差风险的改进。在自然语言和合成数据上的模拟说明了这些收益。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在存在辅助信息的情况下如何进行离散分布估计。作者提出了局部模型和偏序模型，并从理论上分析了辅助信息如何改进均方误差风险。仿真结果表明，在自然语言和合成数据上，辅助信息确实带来了收益。
AI.keywords: 分布估计, 辅助信息, 局部模型, 偏序模型, 均方误差
AI.comments: 该研究将辅助信息引入离散分布估计问题，并提出了两种具体模型进行理论分析和仿真验证，具有一定的理论和应用价值。

title: QuantEval: A Benchmark for Financial Quantitative Tasks in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities across many domains, yet their evaluation in financial quantitative tasks remains fragmented and mostly limited to knowledge-centric question answering. We introduce QuantEval, a benchmark that evaluates LLMs across three essential dimensions of quantitative finance: knowledge-based QA, quantitative mathematical reasoning, and quantitative strategy coding. Unlike prior financial benchmarks, QuantEval integrates a CTA-style backtesting framework that executes model-generated strategies and evaluates them using financial performance metrics, enabling a more realistic assessment of quantitative coding ability. We evaluate some state-of-the-art open-source and proprietary LLMs and observe substantial gaps to human experts, particularly in reasoning and strategy coding. Finally, we conduct large-scale supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning experiments on domain-aligned data, demonstrating consistent improvements. We hope QuantEval will facilitate research on LLMs' quantitative finance capabilities and accelerate their practical adoption in real-world trading workflows. We additionally release the full deterministic backtesting configuration (asset universe, cost model, and metric definitions) to ensure strict reproducibility.

AI.title_translation: 面向大型语言模型金融量化任务的基准测试：QuantEval
AI.tldr: 研究人员创建了一个名为QuantEval的新基准，用于全面测试LLMs在金融量化（包括知识、推理和策略编码）方面的能力，发现现有模型表现不佳，但微调有帮助。该基准包含一个真实的回测系统。
AI.motivation: 金融量化任务中大型语言模型（LLMs）的评估仍然是零散的，并且大多局限于以知识为中心的问答，需要一个更全面的评估体系。
AI.method: 引入QuantEval基准，评估LLM在知识问答、数学推理和策略编码三个维度上的表现，并利用CTA风格的回测框架执行模型生成的策略并评估其财务绩效。此外，还进行了基于领域数据的大规模监督微调和强化学习实验。
AI.result: 评估了最先进的开源和专有LLMs，观察到与人类专家存在显著差距，尤其是在推理和策略编码方面。通过微调和强化学习实验，观察到了持续的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 我们希望QuantEval能促进对LLM金融量化能力的进一步研究，并加速其在实际交易工作流程中的应用。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在许多领域展现出强大的能力，然而它们在金融量化任务中的评估仍然是零散的，并且大多局限于以知识为中心的问答。我们引入了QuantEval，一个跨越量化金融三个基本维度的基准，包括基于知识的问答、定量数学推理和定量策略编码。与以往的金融基准不同，QuantEval集成了一个CTA风格的回测框架，该框架执行模型生成的策略并通过财务绩效指标对其进行评估，从而能够更真实地评估量化编码能力。我们评估了一些最先进的开源和专有LLMs，观察到与人类专家存在显著差距，尤其是在推理和策略编码方面。最后，我们对面向领域的对齐数据进行了大规模的监督微调和强化学习实验，证明了持续的改进。我们希望QuantEval能够促进对LLMs金融量化能力的研究，并加速其在实际交易工作流程中的应用。我们还发布了完整的确定性回测配置（资产池、成本模型和指标定义）以确保严格的可复现性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了QuantEval，一个用于评估大型语言模型在金融量化任务中表现的综合性基准。该基准涵盖知识问答、数学推理和策略编码三个维度，并首次集成了一个执行模型生成策略并用财务指标评估的CTA风格回测框架，以更真实地评估量化编码能力。评估结果显示当前LLMs与人类专家存在差距，但通过针对性微调可实现性能提升。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 金融量化, 基准测试, 策略编码, 回测
AI.comments: 该论文的主要创新在于提出了一个集成了回测框架的综合性金融量化基准QuantEval，超越了以往仅关注知识问答的评估方式。其重要性在于提供了一个更贴近实际交易工作流的评估标准，有助于推动LLM在金融量化领域的深入研究和应用。局限性在于评估结果显示LLM与人类专家仍存在显著差距，尤其在推理和策略编码方面。

title: From Adversarial Poetry to Adversarial Tales: An Interpretability Research Agenda
summary: Safety mechanisms in LLMs remain vulnerable to attacks that reframe harmful requests through culturally coded structures. We introduce Adversarial Tales, a jailbreak technique that embeds harmful content within cyberpunk narratives and prompts models to perform functional analysis inspired by Vladimir Propp's morphology of folktales. By casting the task as structural decomposition, the attack induces models to reconstruct harmful procedures as legitimate narrative interpretation. Across 26 frontier models from nine providers, we observe an average attack success rate of 71.3%, with no model family proving reliably robust. Together with our prior work on Adversarial Poetry, these findings suggest that structurally-grounded jailbreaks constitute a broad vulnerability class rather than isolated techniques. The space of culturally coded frames that can mediate harmful intent is vast, likely inexhaustible by pattern-matching defenses alone. Understanding why these attacks succeed is therefore essential: we outline a mechanistic interpretability research agenda to investigate how narrative cues reshape model representations and whether models can learn to recognize harmful intent independently of surface form.

AI.title_translation: 从对抗性诗歌到对抗性故事：一个可解释性研究议程
AI.tldr: 研究人员发现了一种名为“对抗性故事”的新型越狱方法，它利用赛博朋克故事和民间故事结构来欺骗前沿LLM执行有害指令，平均成功率高达71.3%，表明当前的安全防御存在结构性弱点，需要进行更深入的机制可解释性研究。
AI.motivation: LLM的安全机制容易受到重新构建有害请求的攻击，这些攻击利用了文化编码的结构。需要探究结构化基础的越狱为何成功，并制定机制可解释性研究议程来理解叙事线索对模型的影响，以及模型识别有害意图的能力。
AI.method: 引入“对抗性故事”越狱技术，将有害内容嵌入赛博朋克叙事中，并提示模型执行受弗拉基米尔·普罗普民间故事形态学启发的结构分析。通过将任务设定为结构分解，诱导模型将有害程序重构为合法的叙事解释。在来自九个供应商的26个前沿模型上测试了该技术。
AI.result: 在26个前沿模型上，平均攻击成功率为71.3%，没有哪个模型家族能可靠地抵御此类攻击。这表明结构化基础的越狱是一个广泛的漏洞类别。
AI.conclusion: 结构化基础的越狱（如对抗性故事）构成了一类广泛的漏洞，而非孤立的技术。文化编码框架的空间巨大，仅靠模式匹配防御难以穷尽。理解这些攻击成功的原因至关重要，并需要一个机制可解释性研究议程来探究叙事线索如何改变模型表征，以及模型是否能独立于表面形式识别有害意图。
AI.translation: LLM中的安全机制仍然容易受到攻击，这些攻击通过利用文化编码的结构来重构有害请求。我们引入了“对抗性故事”（Adversarial Tales），一种将有害内容嵌入赛博朋克叙事中，并提示模型执行受弗拉基米尔·普罗普民间故事形态学启发的结构分析的越狱技术。通过将任务设定为结构分解，该攻击诱导模型将有害程序重构为合法的叙事解释。在来自九个供应商的26个前沿模型上，我们观察到平均攻击成功率为71.3%，没有哪个模型家族能可靠地保持鲁棒性。连同我们先前关于“对抗性诗歌”的工作，这些发现表明结构化基础的越狱构成了一个广泛的漏洞类别，而非孤立的技术。可以调解有害意图的文化编码框架空间是巨大的，仅靠模式匹配防御很可能无法穷尽。因此，理解这些攻击为何成功至关重要：我们概述了一个机制可解释性研究议程，以研究叙事线索如何重塑模型表征，以及模型是否可以学习独立于表面形式识别有害意图。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“对抗性故事”的新型越狱技术，该技术将有害内容嵌入赛博朋克叙事中，并利用对民间故事形态学的结构分析来诱导LLM执行有害任务。该攻击在26个前沿模型上取得了71.3%的平均成功率，表明基于结构的越狱是一种广泛的安全漏洞。研究呼吁进行机制可解释性研究，以理解叙事如何影响模型表征。
AI.keywords: 对抗性故事, 越狱, 机制可解释性, 文化编码, LLM安全
AI.comments: 这项研究创新性地提出了基于文化编码结构（赛博朋克叙事和普罗普的民间故事形态学）的“对抗性故事”越狱技术，揭示了大型语言模型（LLM）在结构化解释任务中对有害指令的敏感性。71.3%的平均成功率表明这是一个普遍且难以通过简单模式匹配防御解决的漏洞类别。研究的重点在于推动机制可解释性研究，以理解叙事线索如何重塑模型表征。

title: SAM-pose2seg: Pose-Guided Human Instance Segmentation in Crowds
summary: Segment Anything (SAM) provides an unprecedented foundation for human segmentation, but may struggle under occlusion, where keypoints may be partially or fully invisible. We adapt SAM 2.1 for pose-guided segmentation with minimal encoder modifications, retaining its strong generalization. Using a fine-tuning strategy called PoseMaskRefine, we incorporate pose keypoints with high visibility into the iterative correction process originally employed by SAM, yielding improved robustness and accuracy across multiple datasets. During inference, we simplify prompting by selecting only the three keypoints with the highest visibility. This strategy reduces sensitivity to common errors, such as missing body parts or misclassified clothing, and allows accurate mask prediction from as few as a single keypoint. Our results demonstrate that pose-guided fine-tuning of SAM enables effective, occlusion-aware human segmentation while preserving the generalization capabilities of the original model. The code and pretrained models will be available at https://mirapurkrabek.github.io/BBox-Mask-Pose/.

AI.title_translation: 基于姿态的SAM的人群实例分割
AI.tldr: 通过姿态引导和迭代优化，改进了SAM在遮挡情况下的人体实例分割能力。
AI.motivation: SAM在遮挡场景下的人体分割能力不足，需要改进。
AI.method: 修改SAM编码器，并采用PoseMaskRefine策略，结合高可见度关键点进行迭代优化，简化推理时的提示。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上实现了更鲁棒、更精确的遮挡感知人体实例分割，同时保持了SAM的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 姿态引导的SAM微调能够实现有效的、遮挡感知的人体实例分割，并保留了原始模型的泛化能力。
AI.translation: 分割一切（SAM）为人体分割提供了前所未有的基础，但在遮挡情况下可能会遇到困难，此时关键点可能部分或完全不可见。我们通过最小的编码器修改，将SAM 2.1适配于姿态引导的分割，并保留了其强大的泛化能力。通过一种称为PoseMaskRefine的微调策略，我们将可见度高的人体关键点纳入SAM最初采用的迭代校正过程中，从而在多个数据集上提高了鲁棒性和准确性。在推理时，我们通过仅选择三个可见度最高Thus, the paper proposes a method to enhance SAM's human instance segmentation in crowded scenes, particularly addressing occlusion issues by incorporating pose information. The PoseMaskRefine strategy refines segmentation iteratively using visible keypoints, and the inference process is simplified by selecting the most visible keypoints, making the method robust even with limited keypoint information. The results show improved accuracy and robustness while maintaining SAM's generalization capabilities. The code and models will be released.
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为SAM-pose2seg的方法，通过对Segment Anything (SAM) 模型进行姿态引导的微调，以提高其在人群密集和遮挡场景下的人体实例分割能力。研究人员开发了PoseMaskRefine策略，将可见的关键点信息融入SAM的迭代校正过程，从而增强了模型的鲁棒性和准确性。实验证明，该方法在保持SAM原有泛化能力的同时，能够有效处理遮挡问题，仅需少量关键点即可实现精确分割。
AI.keywords: 人体实例分割,SAM,姿态引导,遮挡感知,PoseMaskRefine
AI.comments: 该方法有效地解决了SAM在遮挡场景下的分割痛点，通过引入姿态信息和PoseMaskRefine策略，显著提升了分割的鲁棒性和准确性。代码和预训练模型的发布将有助于该技术的进一步推广和应用。

title: Airy Beamforming for Radiative Near-Field MU-XL-MIMO: Overcoming Half-Space Blockage
summary: The move to next-generation wireless communications with extremely large-scale antenna arrays (ELAAs) brings the communications into the radiative near-field (RNF) region, where distance-aware focusing is feasible. However, high-frequency RNF links are highly vulnerable to blockage in indoor environments dominated by half-space obstacles (walls, corners) that create knife-edge shadows. Conventional near-field focused beams offer high gain in line-of-sight (LoS) scenarios but suffer from severe energy truncation and effective-rank collapse in shadowed regions, often necessitating the deployment of auxiliary hardware such as Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS) to restore connectivity. We propose a beamforming strategy that exploits the auto-bending property of Airy beams to mitigate half-space blockage without additional hardware. The Airy beam is designed to ``ride'' the diffraction edge, accelerating its main lobe into the shadow to restore connectivity. Our contributions are threefold: (i) a Green's function-based RNF multi-user channel model that analytically reveals singular-value collapse behind knife-edge obstacles; (ii) an Airy analog beamforming scheme that optimizes the bending trajectory to recover the effective channel rank; and (iii) an Airy null-steering method that aligns oscillatory nulls with bright-region users to suppress interference in mixed shadow/bright scenarios. Simulations show that the proposed edge-riding Airy strategy achieves a Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) improvement of over 20 dB and restores full-rank connectivity in shadowed links compared to conventional RNF focusing, virtually eliminating outage in geometric shadows and increasing multi-user spectral efficiency by approximately 35\% under typical indoor ELAA configurations. These results demonstrate robust RNF multi-user access in half-space blockage scenarios without relying on RIS.

AI.title_translation: 用于辐射近场多用户超大规模 MIMO 的 Airy 波束成形：克服半空间遮挡
AI.tldr: 为了解决极大规模天线阵列在辐射近场通信中，因墙壁等半空间障碍物导致的严重遮挡问题，研究人员提出了一种基于 Airy 光束的波束成形技术。该技术利用 Airy 光束的“自弯曲”特性，使其能够绕过或穿透遮挡物的边缘，恢复信号传输，性能相比传统聚焦方法有巨大提升，且无需额外硬件。
AI.motivation: 极大规模天线阵列（ELAA）将通信带入辐射近场（RNF）区域，但高频 RNF 链路极易受到室内环境中由墙壁、角落等半空间障碍物造成的阴影遮挡的影响。传统聚焦波束在阴影区域性能急剧下降，通常需要部署额外的硬件（如 RIS）来恢复连接。
AI.method: 提出了一种利用 Airy 光束的自弯曲特性来缓解半空间遮挡的波束成形策略。具体贡献包括：(i) 基于格林函数建立的 RNF 多用户信道模型，揭示了刀刃障碍物后奇异值崩溃的现象；(ii) 优化弯曲轨迹以恢复有效信道秩的 Airy 模拟波束成形方案；(iii) 将振荡零点与亮区用户对齐以抑制混合阴影/亮区场景中干扰的 Airy 零陷导向方法。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提出的边缘骑行 Airy 策略在阴影链路中实现了超过 20 dB 的信噪比（SNR）提升，并恢复了全秩连通性，几乎消除了几何阴影中的中断，同时在典型的室内 ELAA 配置下，多用户频谱效率提高了约 35%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的边缘骑行 Airy 策略在半空间遮挡场景中实现了稳健的 RNF 多用户接入，无需依赖 RIS，性能优于传统 RNF 聚焦。
AI.translation: 向采用极大规模天线阵列（ELAA）的下一代无线通信的转变将通信带入了辐射近场（RNF）区域，在该区域中，距离感知的聚焦是可行的。然而，高频 RNF 链路极易受到室内环境中以半空间障碍物（墙壁、角落）为主导的遮挡的影响，这些障碍物会产生刀刃阴影。传统的近场聚焦波束在视距（LoS）场景中提供高增益，但在阴影区域会遭受严重的能量截断和有效秩崩溃，通常需要部署辅助硬件，如可重构智能表面（RIS），以恢复连通性。我们提出了一种波束成形策略，利用 Airy 光束的自弯曲特性来缓解半空间遮挡，而无需额外的硬件。Airy 光束被设计用于“骑上”衍射边缘，加速其主瓣进入阴影区域以恢复连通性。我们的贡献有三方面：（i）一个基于格林函数的 RNF 多用户信道模型，该模型在刀刃障碍物后分析性地揭示了奇异值崩溃；（ii）一个优化弯曲轨迹以恢复有效信道秩的 Airy 模拟波束成形方案；（iii）一个将振荡零点与亮区用户对齐以抑制混合阴影/亮区场景中干扰的 Airy 零陷导向方法。仿真表明，与传统的 RNF 聚焦相比，所提出的边缘骑行 Airy 策略在阴影链路上实现了超过 20 dB 的信噪比（SNR）提升，并恢复了全秩连通性，在典型室内 ELAA 配置下，几乎消除了几何阴影中的中断，并将多用户频谱效率提高了约 35%。这些结果证明了在半空间遮挡场景中无需依赖 RIS 即可实现稳健的 RNF 多用户接入。
AI.summary: 本文针对辐射近场（RNF）通信中由半空间障碍物导致的严重遮挡问题，提出了一种创新的 Airy 波束成形策略。该策略利用 Airy 光束的自弯曲特性，使其主瓣“骑上”衍射边缘，加速进入阴影区域以恢复连通性，从而无需依赖可重构智能表面（RIS）等辅助硬件。该工作建立了相应的信道模型，并设计了优化弯曲轨迹和抑制干扰的波束成形方案，仿真验证了其在提升 SNR 和频谱效率方面的显著优势。
AI.keywords: 空域波束成形, 辐射近场, 极大规模天线阵列, Airy 光束, 半空间遮挡
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于利用 Airy 光束的自弯曲特性来克服半空间遮挡，而无需额外的硬件（如 RIS），这在 RNF 通信中具有重要意义。其方法具有理论深度，通过建模揭示了奇异值崩溃，并提出了具体的波束成形和零陷导向方案。结果表明性能提升显著。

title: AviationLMM: A Large Multimodal Foundation Model for Civil Aviation
comments: Accepted by 2025 7th International Conference on Interdisciplinary Computer Science and Engineering (ICICSE 2025), Chongqing, China; 9 pages,1 figure,5 tables
summary: Civil aviation is a cornerstone of global transportation and commerce, and ensuring its safety, efficiency and customer satisfaction is paramount. Yet conventional Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions in aviation remain siloed and narrow, focusing on isolated tasks or single modalities. They struggle to integrate heterogeneous data such as voice communications, radar tracks, sensor streams and textual reports, which limits situational awareness, adaptability, and real-time decision support. This paper introduces the vision of AviationLMM, a Large Multimodal foundation Model for civil aviation, designed to unify the heterogeneous data streams of civil aviation and enable understanding, reasoning, generation and agentic applications. We firstly identify the gaps between existing AI solutions and requirements. Secondly, we describe the model architecture that ingests multimodal inputs such as air-ground voice, surveillance, on-board telemetry, video and structured texts, and performs cross-modal alignment and fusion, and produces flexible outputs ranging from situation summaries and risk alerts to predictive diagnostics and multimodal incident reconstructions. In order to fully realize this vision, we identify key research opportunities to address, including data acquisition, alignment and fusion, pretraining, reasoning, trustworthiness, privacy, robustness to missing modalities, and synthetic scenario generation. By articulating the design and challenges of AviationLMM, we aim to boost the civil aviation foundation model progress and catalyze coordinated research efforts toward an integrated, trustworthy and privacy-preserving aviation AI ecosystem.
comment: Accepted by 2025 7th International Conference on Interdisciplinary Computer Science and Engineering (ICICSE 2025), Chongqing, China; 9 pages,1 figure,5 tables

AI.title_translation: 民用航空的航空大型多模态基础模型
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了AviationLMM，一个用于民用航空的大型多模态基础模型，旨在整合异构数据流以增强理解、推理、生成和代理应用，并指出了实现这一愿景所需解决的关键研究领域。
AI.motivation: 传统的航空人工智能解决方案是孤立且狭窄的，难以整合语音通信、雷达轨迹、传感器流和文本报告等异构数据，这限制了态势感知、适应性和实时决策支持。
AI.method: 该模型能摄取空地语音、监视、机载遥测、视频和结构化文本等多模态输入，进行跨模态对齐和融合，并产生从态势摘要和风险警报到预测性诊断和多模态事件重建的灵活输出。
AI.conclusion: 通过阐述AviationLMM的设计和挑战，旨在推动民用航空基础模型的进展，并催化协调的研究工作，以实现一个集成、可信和保护隐私的航空人工智能生态系统。
AI.translation: 民用航空是全球交通和商业的基石，确保其安全、高效和客户满意度至关重要。然而，航空领域传统的“人工智能”（AI）解决方案仍然是孤立且狭窄的，专注于孤立的任务或单一的模态。它们难以整合异构数据，如语音通信、雷达轨迹、传感器流和文本报告，这限制了态势感知、适应性和实时决策支持。本文提出了AviationLMM的愿景，一个用于民用航空的大型多模态基础模型，旨在统一民用航空的异构数据流，并实现理解、推理、生成和代理应用。我们首先确定了现有AI解决方案与要求之间的差距。其次，我们描述了模型架构，该架构摄取多模态输入，如空地语音、监视、机载遥测、视频和结构化文本，并执行跨模态对齐和融合，产生灵活的输出，范围从态势摘要和风险警报到预测性诊断和多模态事件重建。为了充分实现这一愿景，我们确定了需要解决的关键研究机会，包括数据采集、对齐和融合、预训练、推理、可信度、隐私、对缺失模态的鲁棒性以及合成场景生成。通过阐述AviationLMM的设计和挑战，我们旨在推动民用航空基础模型的进展，并催化协调的研究工作，以实现一个集成、可信和保护隐私的航空人工智能生态系统。
AI.summary: AviationLMM是一个针对民用航空领域的大型多模态基础模型，旨在解决传统AI解决方案在整合异构数据方面的局限性。该模型能够处理和融合多种数据模态，实现更强的理解、推理和生成能力，为航空安全、效率和客户满意度提供支持。论文还探讨了实现该模型所需面临的关键研究挑战。
AI.keywords: 大型多模态模型,民用航空,数据融合,人工智能,基础模型
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一个具有前瞻性的模型AviationLMM，旨在解决民用航空领域AI应用的碎片化问题。通过整合多模态数据，该模型有望显著提升航空系统的智能化水平。然而，论文主要侧重于模型愿景和挑战的阐述，具体的模型性能和实验结果尚未在摘要中提及，这是未来研究可以关注的重点。

title: Vision-Conditioned Variational Bayesian Last Layer Dynamics Models
summary: Agile control of robotic systems often requires anticipating how the environment affects system behavior. For example, a driver must perceive the road ahead to anticipate available friction and plan actions accordingly. Achieving such proactive adaptation within autonomous frameworks remains a challenge, particularly under rapidly changing conditions. Traditional modeling approaches often struggle to capture abrupt variations in system behavior, while adaptive methods are inherently reactive and may adapt too late to ensure safety. We propose a vision-conditioned variational Bayesian last-layer dynamics model that leverages visual context to anticipate changes in the environment. The model first learns nominal vehicle dynamics and is then fine-tuned with feature-wise affine transformations of latent features, enabling context-aware dynamics prediction. The resulting model is integrated into an optimal controller for vehicle racing. We validate our method on a Lexus LC500 racing through water puddles. With vision-conditioning, the system completed all 12 attempted laps under varying conditions. In contrast, all baselines without visual context consistently lost control, demonstrating the importance of proactive dynamics adaptation in high-performance applications.

AI.title_translation: 视觉条件化变分贝叶斯最后一层动态模型
